objective: Compute a compact rolling-horizon battery and diesel dispatch for a renewable microgrid.

objective.en: Dispatch a battery and diesel unit across short intervals while preserving SOC and minimizing diesel cost.
objective.ru: Задать батарею и дизельный агрегат на коротких интервалах с сохранением SOC и минимизацией стоимости дизеля.

instructions.en: Use rolling_microgrid_dispatch_case. For each 5-minute interval choose battery_mw, positive for discharge and negative for charge. Respect battery power/SOC limits and diesel pmin/pmax; PV curtailment is allowed and load shedding is not. Report per-interval dispatch and total_cost. Any battery schedule achieving the minimum cost is accepted; feasible but more expensive schedules receive partial credit by cost gap.
instructions.ru: Используйте rolling_microgrid_dispatch_case. Для каждого 5-минутного интервала выберите battery_mw: положительное значение — разряд, отрицательное — заряд. Соблюдайте ограничения батареи по мощности/SOC и ограничения дизеля pmin/pmax; ограничение PV допустимо, отключение нагрузки — нет. Укажите dispatch по интервалам и total_cost. Принимается любой профиль батареи с минимальной стоимостью; допустимые, но более дорогие решения получают частичный балл по разрыву стоимости.

submission_schema.dispatch: object mapping timestamp to diesel_mw, battery_mw, pv_curtailment_mw, soc_mwh, shed_mw
submission_schema.total_cost: diesel energy cost over the horizon

hard_constraints: The submitted battery schedule, re-simulated by the evaluator, must respect SOC bounds and serve all load without shedding.
Per-period diesel, SOC, curtailment, and shedding values must be consistent with the submitted battery schedule; total_cost must match the re-simulated cost.
Any feasible dispatch is admissible: equal-cost alternative optima receive full score, suboptimal feasible dispatch receives partial credit by cost gap.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether the re-simulated battery schedule satisfies SOC and load-serving constraints and the submission is internally consistent.

metrics.name: score
metrics.description: 1.0 at the optimal cost; otherwise max(0, 1 - cost_gap/optimal_cost).

metrics.name: cost_gap_usd
metrics.description: Achieved cost minus the enumerated optimal cost.
